content.terms: Working estimate based on the current RMS charge total for order #1790. Tax treatment, final scope, venue and schedule remain subject to confirmation.
content.title: Draft Party — Working Proposal
content.summary: Bring the draft into the room with a main stage, live sound, two LED walls and lighting that carries the energy into the VIP spaces. This working proposal brings the quoted production together around one event experience, with venue, dimensions and schedule still to be confirmed.
content.nextSteps: Confirm the venue, stage and LED wall dimensions, programme timing and tax treatment. We can then finalize the scope and production schedule for approval.
content.delivery: Production planning, prep, delivery, setup, show support and strike are included. Venue access, programme timing, the control-room handoff and crew scheduling need to be aligned before the production schedule is confirmed.
content.experience: The main stage anchors the programme. The LED walls receive a dedicated control-room feed, while the audio package supports announcements, the band and DJ. Stage lighting shapes the main presentation; VIP uplights and custom gobos create atmosphere across the plaza and concourse.
content.scope:
Main audio — Ground-stacked L'Acoustics PA, wireless microphones, and band/DJ support.

Stage lighting — Wash fixtures, moving fixtures, haze and lighting control.

Video — Two ground-supported Absen LED walls, processing and control-room handoff.

Staging — Main stage with safety railing, stairs, skirting, risers for video/camera/FOH, backdrop and drape per the current RMS order.

VIP spaces — Astera uplights and custom gobo packages for the plaza and concourse.

Production support — Pre-production management, setup/show/strike crew, power distribution, cabling and trucking.
